notes.title: 《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》即将登录Steam平台
notes.content:
方块游戏将与Gamera Games联合发行轩辕剑系列经典游戏《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》，Steam商店页面已公开，欢迎加入愿望单！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638230
 《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》是由大宇资讯开发的经典回合制角色扮演游戏，讲述了主人公赛特为求真理，从威尼斯出发，途经地中海、阿拉伯等地，最后到达大唐帝国。一路上与形形色色的人物遭遇，发生了各种各样的故事。
 
本作承袭优美传统的国画风格，横跨整个欧亚大陆，贯穿法兰克、阿拉伯、中国三个文明，将历史舞台与中西神话完美结合。
 
本次《轩辕剑叁：云和山的彼端》相比初版本进行了全方位的优化并补充了新的内容，详情如下：
[list]
[*] 画面比例优化16:9（旧版为4:3）
[*] 支持高清晰度（旧版为640*480）
[*] 物品贴图高清化
[*] 优化界面操作
[*] 支持手柄操作
[*] 包含手机版新增的中国篇剧情[/list]
其中手机版新增的中国篇剧情，将丰富主角赛特在当时中国唐朝中发生的剧情。而当中究竟有什么样的新境遇，以及会迸发什么样的新火花，届时欢迎各位玩家前去挖掘！

支持高清晰度（旧版为640*480）
物品贴图高清化
优化界面操作
支持手柄操作
包含手机版新增的中国篇剧情

notes.title: Summer Sale Surprise!! Patch V1.01110623
notes.content:
The Gate of Firmament Summer Sale is coming!
In order to show our gratitude to fans for supporting The Gate of Firmament, we have a gift to you, a new patch!!!

PATCH NOTES
Optimizing the translation of English for purpose of giving you a better understanding of Chinese culture.

REVISED ITEMS
1. Revising some problems of sound effect.
2. Adjusting some subtitle in CG.

The Patch will update automatically and if the game doesn’t update, please restart your Steam client. We hope that the update will give you a better gameplay experience. Meanwhile, DOMO Studio will go ahead with collecting your feedback in order to promote the gameplay experience for you.

Steam Store： http://store.steampowered.com/app/427030

notes.title: The Gate of Firmament Patch V1.01110316
notes.content:
The first update will mainly revise the following bugs, adjust some items and add some new functions of UI.
The Patch will update automatically and if the game doesn’t update, please restart your Steam client.

New Items Added：
A switch to control AI use items in the battle field.
‧LMB/Confirm Button/ Button A of Controller can skip the dialogue sentence by sentence.(Notes: Not anytime)

Revised Items
‧System： Revising the bug of game menu.
‧Minigames： Revising the bug that the controller is not available in some minigames
‧Battle field： Revising the bug when starting battle field.
‧Language： Revising the bug when switch the different languages
‧Achievement： Revising the bug that some achievements that can‘t be acquired.
‧UI： Revising the display of character，conversation and battle field.
‧Savedata： Revising the bug about save game.
‧Game Control： Revising the controller experience and change the Escape Shortcut Key to Back 
‧Music： Adjusting some BMG of Boss Battle.
‧Scenes： Adjusting the scene of Sishui
‧Story： Revising the bug about Role-floating in some cases.
‧Skill： Revising the wrong instruction of Element conversion

We hope that the update will give you a better gameplay experience. Meanwhile, DOMO Studio will go ahead with collecting your feedback in order to promote the gameplay experience for you.

Notice: To prevent the motion errors, the feature may not work in some cases.

notes.title: Advance Notice of the first Patch Update on March 11,2016
notes.content:
In order to give you a better game experience,
DOMO Studio plans to release the new patch on March 11, 2016. The new patch will add:
1. A switch to control AI use items in the battle field.
2. The support to controller in Windows10…and so on.
More details will reveal on March 11, 2016.

Before the updating of new patch，we suggested that you can take following steps:
If you use the Xbox One controller in WIN7，you‘d better click the official website：
http://support.xbox.com/ms-MY/xbox-on-windows/accessories/connect-xbox-one-controller-to-pc
to update the latest driver of your controller.

If you use the Xbox One controller in WIN10,you ‘d better download Official Update KB3140743 of Win10 system besides the latest driver of your controller:
http://support.xbox.com/ms-MY/xbox-on-windows/accessories/connect-xbox-one-controller-to-pc

If you use PS4 controller，you‘d better download a software to get the support. ( http://forums.pcsx2.net/Thread-DS4-To-XInput-Wrapper )
Because the software is based on Xbox360 controller，you‘d better setup the Driver of Xbox360 controller on your PC in the previous.

tags.feature: 1. A switch to control AI use items in the battle field.
2. The support to controller in Windows10…
